spec_provided_security_features.name: Address-space privilege property
spec_provided_security_features.purpose: TileLink address-space properties include 'privilege level' as a per-region property, allowing slave-side privilege checks at the bus layer. Specific enforcement mechanism is outside spec scope.

spec_provided_security_features.name: c_error / d_error bits
spec_provided_security_features.purpose: Single-bit error fields allow compliant response generation even when data corruption is detected, supporting safe degradation rather than silent failure.

what_is_NOT_in_the_spec: No confidentiality / encryption at the protocol layer (no AES, no cipher).
No data-integrity / authentication (no MAC, no HMAC, no signature).
No secure-vs-nonsecure transaction marker (unlike AXI's AxPROT[1] or ARM's TrustZone NS bit).
No interface parity / fault-detection bits (unlike AHB5's optional parity).
No source-identity authentication; a_source identifiers are not cryptographically bound to issuing master.
No hardware-enforced access-control or sandbox (deferred to SoC integration via PMP / IOPMP / firewall).
integrator_responsibility_summary: Privilege / secure-vs-nonsecure / cacheability / FIFO ordering are per-region properties of the address space, declared at SoC integration time.

SoC integrator must combine TileLink with external firewalls (e.g. RISC-V IOPMP, ARM TZASC, custom address-bound permission checkers) to enforce confidentiality and integrity at the address range level.
If cryptographic guarantees are required, they must be added at the master agent or at a memory-protection-unit / encryption-unit slave agent — not inside the TileLink network itself.

evidence.quote: Properties that might be ascribed to an address space include: TileLink conformance level, memory consistency model, cacheability, FIFO ordering requirements, executeability, privelege level, and any Quality-of-Service guarantees.
As every TileLink request message requires a mandatory response message of a mandatory size, this field allows compliant messages to be created even when data corruption is detected by an agent.
